name: IR Night Vision Clip
description: IR clip with 850nm LED + Night Mode in app. Clip alone does NOT give night vision - Must turn on Night filter in app. 850nm = visible red glow, 940nm = invisible.
ledNote: 850nm = visible red glow. 940nm = invisible, better for animals.

name: Night God - Night HDR Software
description: Night HDR software mode - Brightness + HDR filter + Night filter in app. Not 10-frame fusion - No 10-frame code in app. Works on any camera.
use: Night shop, night doc scan, dark room
